why: I checked all four must_catch items, and the third one fails. Item 1 is handled: builder step 7 says "Run `npm install` at the root so package-lock.json includes the new workspace". Item 2 is handled: step 6 says "replace that with a list that includes jsonl-lint". Item 4 is handled: verifier check 6 uses `gh pr view` (body, headRefOid) and `gh pr checks` to confirm the test check succeeded at the head commit. Item 3 is missed. The verifier runs `npm test -w jsonl-lint` directly and requires only that root `npm test` "exits 0". With `--if-present`, the root script could skip the jsonl-lint tests and still exit 0. Nothing in the verifier brief reads the test count from the root run or breaks lint() to see a test fail, so skipped tests would go unnoticed.
